source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001]

To begin, I’m sorry it took us so long to respond. We needed to speak with Upwork and confirm that everything was configured properly, with [FREELANCER_NAME_002] right contract structure in place to protect both you and us before proceeding. That is [FREELANCER_NAME_002] standard we follow.

Here is [FREELANCER_NAME_002] current situation:

More than 40 people applied to join this team. We reviewed each application closely and are advancing only [FREELANCER_NAME_002] top 5. You are among those selected.

[FREELANCER_NAME_005] selection was not by chance. [FREELANCER_NAME_005] application caught our attention, and we believe you have [FREELANCER_NAME_002] ability to contribute to something that will grow into a significant operation.

[FREELANCER_NAME_002] trial will work as follows:

Using Teyron's content, you will produce 15 to 20 clips in accordance with [FREELANCER_NAME_002] brand guidelines previously provided in [FREELANCER_NAME_002] Notion workspace. Compensation is a flat $1 per clip. Strong, consistent quality can also earn an additional bonus, with no limit on what high-quality work can earn.

After finishing [FREELANCER_NAME_002] clips, you will submit a milestone through Upwork, and [FREELANCER_NAME_002] payment will be released. [FREELANCER_NAME_002] process is straightforward and provides protection for both parties.

Following [FREELANCER_NAME_002] trial, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] strongest performers will join our in-house operation under a performance-based compensation model that includes bonuses. That is when [FREELANCER_NAME_002] real earning opportunity begins. People who deliver consistently will also have a path into leadership within this operation, including a base salary and responsibility for managing a team.

We are creating something genuine here. Those who act quickly and execute well will gain [FREELANCER_NAME_002] greatest benefit from getting involved early.

Do you want to join?

— [CLIENT_NAME_001]
Content Operations Manager, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] Teyron Machine

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
Nice work — you were [FREELANCER_NAME_002] only clipper to complete everything before [FREELANCER_NAME_002] deadline, and [FREELANCER_NAME_002] quality showed it. [FREELANCER_NAME_002] moment capturing was spot-on, and [FREELANCER_NAME_002] font selection worked nicely.
There are just two minor adjustments to make going forward:

One clip was too short — clips must be 30-90 seconds so [FREELANCER_NAME_002] message/goal is delivered fully, so remember to stay within that range.
[FREELANCER_NAME_002] captions/letters had no color — adding some color will make them stand out more and help improve watch time.

Neither issue is significant; they are only finishing touches. Overall, this was a strong first set, and you're hired.
Payment for these clips will be sent on Monday. After that, you'll be onboarded properly with an improved guideline video that explains exactly how we make a clip, including [FREELANCER_NAME_002] do's and don'ts and what is expected.
There's one more thing — you'll serve as [FREELANCER_NAME_002] lead clipper for a pod of 6 clippers. You'll continue producing [FREELANCER_NAME_005] own clips, while also approving [FREELANCER_NAME_002] clips made by [FREELANCER_NAME_002] other 5, ensuring [FREELANCER_NAME_002] pod operates smoothly, and making sure everyone meets [FREELANCER_NAME_002] standard. Before it begins, I'll explain exactly how that will work, but I wanted to tell you now because it's a larger responsibility than clipping alone.
Congratulations — speak soon.

execution.observed_behavior: After reviewing the submitted set, the client confirms that the extended trial was completed before the deadline, rates it as a strong first set, and accepts the freelancer for continued work despite two minor clip-level adjustments.

routing_warnings.description: The finding that one clip was too short and the new 30–90-second rule concern the independent clip-duration Requirement.
The instruction to add color to captions concerns the independent caption-presentation Requirement.
The pause on making additional clips applies to future recurring production, not the already completed extended trial batch.
The new assignment for three perfect clips begins the separate requalification trajectory rather than modifying the completed extended trial.
